thomas-greeting.speaker: Thomas
thomas-greeting.text: Good to see you out here by the mill. The morning breeze is calm, though the northern ridge has felt a little restless lately.

choices.label: Heard strange sounds near the cave.

thomas-mill-status.speaker: Thomas
thomas-mill-status.text: Nothing we can't handle with a steady hand and a good day's work. Grab whatever supplies you need from the homestead before heading out.

thomas-cave-warning.speaker: Thomas
thomas-cave-warning.text: Aye—keep your wits about you if you head toward the cave entrance. Don't go in unprepared, and let me know if you find out what's stirring up trouble.

choices.label: I'll go check the cave entrance.

thomas-farewell.speaker: Thomas
thomas-farewell.text: Watch your step out there, and come back safe.
